anomalies.obs: On sheet 1 (Power Train), the part placed in the series 'Reverse polarity protection' position between F1 and the +24V bulk rail is T3 = AON6407, an N-channel MOSFET (source pin 2 on the input side, drain pin 3 on the +24V output side). Its gate (pin 1) is tapped from a divider of R7 (33 kΩ to the input node) and D3 (12 V zener to GND), so the gate sits near 0–12 V while the source sits at +24 V.
anomalies.expected: The specification's power architecture lists the input path as 'F1 (fuse) ─► D2 (TVS clamp) ─► /+24V_FB' with no series switch, and identifies T3 (AON6407) as the 'ATO solenoid-valve low-side switch' driving the ATO_VALVE net, not as an input device. A high-side series reverse-polarity switch with this gate bias (gate pulled toward ground, zener clamp) requires a P-channel MOSFET; an N-channel device here has Vgs ≈ −12 V and can never turn on.

evidence.quote: Sheet 1, Power Train: 'Reverse polarity protection' above 'T3 AON6407' in series on the +24Vin→+24V path, with 'R7 33k' and 'D3 12V' biasing the gate toward GND (page 1, row A).
T3 — AON6407 (8-DFN N-MOSFET) | ATO solenoid-valve low-side switch | Netlist: drives ATO_VALVE net; gate driven through R10 (100 Ω), pre-driven via T4 (BT3904).
24V external supply ... ├─► F1 (fuse) ─► D2 (TVS clamp) ─► /+24V_FB ──► +24V bulk rail

anomalies.impact: With an N-channel AON6407 in this P-channel topology, the gate never receives positive Vgs relative to the source, so the 24 V rail is blocked and the entire board (buck, LDO, pumps, sensors) never powers up.

anomalies.obs: On sheet 3 (ATO Valve tile), the solenoid-valve low-side switch is T5 = AO3400A (a 30 V, SOT-23 small-signal N-MOSFET), pre-driven by T4 (BT3904) through R10 (100 Ω), switching the +24 V ATO valve load.
anomalies.expected: The specification states the ATO valve switch is T3 — AON6407 (8-DFN N-MOSFET), a power device sized for the valve load; the drawing instead uses the 30 V AO3400A, leaving only ~6 V of off-state margin on a 24 V inductive load.

evidence.quote: Sheet 3, 'ATO Valve': 'R10 100Ω' from ATO_VALVE to 'T4 BT3904' base, 'R11 4k7' from FLOAT_HIGH, T4 collector to gate of 'T5 AO3400A' switching the BATD/+24V valve path (page 3, row F).
T3 — AON6407 (8-DFN N-MOSFET) | ATO solenoid-valve low-side switch | Netlist: drives ATO_VALVE net

anomalies.impact: The valve is switched by a part with marginal voltage/current rating for a 24 V inductive load; combined with the relocated T3, the actuator chain deviates from the specified design and risks MOSFET failure on the valve.

parsed.summary: The drawing deviates from the specified design in the 24 V input path: T3 (AON6407, an N-channel MOSFET) is placed as a series reverse-polarity switch with a P-channel-style gate bias (R7/D3 to ground), which would leave the 24 V rail permanently off, and the ATO valve is switched by T5 (AO3400A, 30 V) rather than the specified AON6407.
